label: reconstructed from public reports
source: FATF and Egmont Group (2020), Trade-Based Money Laundering: Trends and Developments, FATF, Paris. https://www.fatf-gafi.org/en/publications/Methodsandtrends/Trade-based-money-laundering-trends-and-developments.html
what_happened: Drug cash was paid to a complicit US merchant exporting consumer electronics; Colombian importers paid pesos to money brokers, so no cash crossed the border.
reconstruction: Fairly priced, fully documented electronics exports. The laundering is in who pays, which invoice data does not show.
